summary: Brent above $111 on escalating Houthi strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure is this week's dominant cross-cutting driver, mixed for India's energy complex; a cluster of trade-policy relief (US tariff locked at 18%, NZ FTA live, gems tariff threat waived) removes downside for exporters, while a confirmed Rs1.64 lakh cr semiconductor-mission tally, a dated National Steel Policy draft, and a zero-ethanol-diversion mandate that crashed sugar stocks round out a week with as many real policy decisions as macro shocks.
